text: Marex Group plc's ordinary shares began trading on the Nasdaq Global Select Market (ticker MRX) on 25 April 2024, after an IPO priced at $19.00 per share in which both the company and existing 'Selling Shareholders' sold shares.

source.name: Marex Group plc: 'Marex Group plc announces pricing of initial public offering'
source.quote: The ordinary shares are expected to begin trading on the Nasdaq Global Select Market on April 25, 2024, under the ticker symbol “MRX.”
